brand.title: Who does this feed speak for?
brand.description: The name, brand, or studio this feed speaks for.

instagramHandle.title: Instagram handle
instagramHandle.description: Instagram handle (e.g. @studio). Leave empty if unused.

visualStyle.title: Visual style
visualStyle.description: One sentence on how the feed should look — seeded into style-guide.md.
visualStyle.default: Natural light, honest color, one subject per image.

voice.title: Tone of voice
voice.description: One sentence on tone of voice for captions.
voice.default: Warm, plain, and human — never corporate.

cadence.title: Posting cadence
cadence.description: Target posting cadence (e.g. 4 images a week).

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: See the whole post pipeline: every post with its status, platforms, and dates. Optionally filter by status or platform.

status.description: Only posts currently in this status.

platform.description: Only posts targeting this platform, e.g. 'bluesky'.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one post in full: frontmatter, body, each platform variant with its character count (and permalink once live), and media files.

id.description: Post id — its folder name under posts/, e.g. '2026-08-12-launch-teaser'.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Commit the staged posts/_drafting/ folder as a real post. Stage post.md (frontmatter + body), variants/, and media/ there first; the post folder is named from the created date and slug.

status.description: Initial status for the new post. Defaults to approved.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Patch a post's frontmatter (fields object; null clears a key) and/or move it one pipeline stage. Stages run idea, draft, in-review, approved, scheduled, published — archived from anywhere.

status.description: Target status (one stage at a time).

tools.name: record_publication
tools.description: The moment a variant goes live, stamp it with its permalink and platform post id. The post flips to published once every target platform is stamped (or markPublished is passed).

platform.description: The platform that went live, e.g. 'bluesky'.

permalink.description: Public URL of the live post.

postId.description: The platform's own id for the live post.

corpusRef.description: Connector corpus record reference, when one exists.

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp it went live (defaults to now).

markPublished.description: Force the post to published even with unstamped platforms.

tools.name: page_set_status
tools.description: Page-only: move a post between pipeline columns on the gallery.

status.description: The column the post was moved to.

reaction.prompt: [Feed gallery]: The user moved post {{output.id}} to '{{output.status}}' on the gallery. Reply with ONE short line acknowledging the move. If it landed in 'draft', offer to run the draft-social-post craftbook on it. Do not restate the pipeline.

tools.name: page_get_post
tools.description: Page-only: the detail drawer's read of one post with variants and media.

notes: posts/index.json is seeded at its subpath (applyProjectType preserves seed subpaths and creates parents) and is ALSO regenerated by posts-store on every mutation, so the gallery tolerates a missing or stale index. Posts live one folder per post under posts/ (post.md + variants/ + media/), staged in posts/_drafting/ until create_post commits them. page_set_status and page_get_post are the page-only twins of update_post/get_post — pages.tools names are removed from the model surface, so the model keeps its own read tools.
